definitions.full: H6429. Pelesheth מְּלֶ֫שֶׁת proper name, of a territory Philistia , in poetry and late; — מְּלָ֑שֶׁת (ישְׁבֵי) Exod 15:14 ( Φυλιστιειμ ; elsewhere ( οἱ ) ἀλλόφυλοι ), Joel 4:4, elsewhere מְּלֶשֶׁת Isa 14:29 , 31 ; Psa 60:10 = 108:10 ; 83:8 ; 87:4 ; Assyrian Palastu , Pilistu , COT Gen 10:14 Dl pa 288 f. Greek Παλαιστίνη Herod ii. 104, 106, vii. 89 Jos Ant. i. 6 . 2 (also Φυλιστίνου ); see Rel Pal. 73 f .

occurrences.englishText: Assyria also is joined with them.
I will record Rahab* Rahab is a reference to Egypt. and Babylon among those who acknowledge me.
Who will bring me into the fortified city?
Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
